items: Wash and peel the potatoes, then slice them about 0.2 cm thin — the thinner they are, the less microwave time they need.
Soak the slices in water for 20 minutes, then pat them dry.
Spread the slices out without overlapping on a sheet of baking paper, brush each with oil, and sprinkle with a little sugar and salt.
Microwave on high for 4 minutes, watching that they don't scorch.
Reheat any that aren't crisp yet in 1-minute bursts until done — about 5–7 minutes total.

zh.name: 微波馬鈴薯脆片（洋芋片）

items: 馬鈴薯洗淨削皮後，切為約 0.2 公分薄度——愈薄所需微波時間愈短。
分散擺放於烘焙紙上、不要重疊，個別刷油，再撒上適量砂糖及鹽巴調味。
放進微波爐以大火力先加熱 4 分鐘，持續注意烤焦情況。
沒脆者再以每次加 1 分鐘為間隔慢慢加熱，約 5～7 分鐘即可全數完成。
